prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene unfolds within a sunlit botanical greenhouse. On the left, an elderly woman in a floral apron stands beside a tall fern, her posture slightly bent as she tends to the leaves. Next to the boy, a ginger cat curls into a tight ball, sleeping peacefully amidst the scattered gardening tools. To the right, a man in a striped shirt points toward the glass ceiling, drawing the attention of a woman in a yellow dress who stands beside him, looking up with curiosity. Above them, hanging from the iron framework, is a vibrant orchid in full bloom, its petals delicately shaded. There is no electronic equipment visible in this tranquil setting. The elderly woman reaches out to touch a leaf, interacting gently with the plant life. The man in the striped shirt gestures specifically for the woman in the yellow dress, creating a shared moment of discovery. The boy remains absorbed in his tiny world, ignoring the adults. The ginger cat remains undisturbed by the activity. The orchid hangs suspended, adding vertical interest. The fern provides a lush backdrop on the left. The stone floor anchors the composition. The glass panels allow soft light to filter through. The iron beams provide structural contrast. The scene captures a quiet afternoon of observation and care.
